LESSON: SARUFI 7.4.1 VIELEZI MAHALI IDADI

Grade: Grade 9
Subject: KISWAHILI
Strand: Strand 7
Topic 7.4: Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi

SEHEMU 1: KARIBU

Habari! Leo tutajifunza kuhusu Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi. Soma, angalia mifano, fanya mazoezi, kisha jaribu jaribio la marekebisho.

SEHEMU 2: UTAPATA KUJUA NINI

Mwisho wa somo hili, utaweza:

1. kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini
2. kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini

SEHEMU 3: JIFUNZE HATUA KWA HATUA

1. kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

2. kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini
   In simple words: practise until you can kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini. Use examples from school and home in Kenya.

SEHEMU 4: MIFANO

Example 1: Talk about Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi using something you see at school in Kenya.

Example 2: Give a home example from your county, estate, or village.

Example 3: Teach a younger child one idea from this lesson in simple words.

SEHEMU 5: JARIBU HIVI

1. Underline two new ideas about Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi in the examples.
2. Explain Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi to a parent using one local example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi.
4. Show that you can: kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini

SEHEMU 6: KAZI YA KUFANYA

1. Write five sentences about Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi using examples from school or home.
2. Answer: Why is Sarufi 7.4.1 Vielezi mahali idadi important for a Grade 9 learner?
3. Make a one-minute oral presentation to a parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SEHEMU: KUMBUKA

1. kutambua vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi katika matini
2. kutumia vielezi vya mahali na vya idadi ipasavyo katika matini

Sasa fanya Jaribio la Marekebisho. Angalia Majibu baada tu ya kumaliza.
